steps.name: Refuse anything but a tag build
steps.run: if [ "$REF_TYPE" != tag ]; then echo "::error::sigstore-sign signs tag builds only (ref_type=$REF_TYPE, $REF_NAME)"; exit 1; fi

steps.name: Refuse a tag that is not on main
Sign every file, keyless
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir "$WORK/bundles"; : > "$WORK/manifest.txt"; : > "$WORK/rekor.txt"
n=0
while IFS= read -r f; do
  f="${f#./}"
  sha256sum -- "$f" >> "$WORK/manifest.txt"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$WORK/bundles/$f")"
  cosign sign-blob --yes --new-bundle-format --bundle "$WORK/bundles/$f.sigstore.json" -- "$f" > /dev/null
  idx=$(jq -r '.verificationMaterial.tlogEntries[0].logIndex // empty' "$WORK/bundles/$f.sigstore.json")
  [ -n "$idx" ] || { echo "::error::no Rekor log index in the bundle for $f"; exit 1; }
  echo "$f=$idx" >> "$WORK/rekor.txt"
  n=$((n + 1))
done < <(find . -type f ! -name '*.sigstore.json' | LC_ALL=C sort)
[ "$n" -ge 1 ] || { echo "::error::artifact $ARTIFACT_NAME held no files to sign"; exit 1; }
b=$(find "$WORK/bundles" -name "*.sigstore.json" | LC_ALL=C sort | head -1)
# the identity is READ from the Fulcio certificate, never typed: it is what a verifier will see
id=$(jq -r ".verificationMaterial.certificate.rawBytes // .verificationMaterial.x509CertificateChain.certificates[0].rawBytes" "$b" | base64 -d | openssl x509 -inform DER -noout -ext subjectAltName | grep -o "https://[^, ]*" | head -1)
[ -n "$id" ] || { echo "::error::no signer identity in the certificate of $b"; exit 1; }
{
  echo "sha256<<EOF_SHA"; cat "$WORK/manifest.txt"; echo "EOF_SHA"
  echo "rekor-index<<EOF_REK"; cat "$WORK/rekor.txt"; echo "EOF_REK"
  echo "bundle=sigstore-bundles-$TAG"
  echo "tag=$TAG"
  echo "identity=$id"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Attach the bundles to the release

artifact-name.description: actions/upload-artifact name holding the files to sign (the caller uploaded them)

runs-on.description: JSON array of runner labels; REQUIRED, no default (hosted runners are banned, so there is no safe one to assume)

upload-to-release.description: attach each .sigstore.json bundle to the tag release (needs contents: write)

bundle.description: name of the artifact holding the <file>.sigstore.json bundles

identity.description: the certificate identity (the SAN): this workflow at the ref the caller pinned; pass it to sigstore-verify.sh as <identity>

rekor-index.description: Rekor log index of each bundle, "<name>=<index>" per line

sha256.description: sha256sum manifest of the signed files (one "<hex>  <name>" line each)
